amenitiesDescription: The amenity program is built around E11EVEN's hospitality pedigree: a Chopra Spa and Studio, a resort pool with private lounge areas on the ninth level, a rooftop bar and lounge on the 64th floor, and a casino-style sports lounge. The members-only Clayton club sits on the second level, fully staffed executive office suites on the eighth, and a private rooftop helipad crowns the tower, pending FAA approval. A one-way sky bridge connects residents to the amenities of the original E11EVEN Club Hotel and Residences.
description: E11EVEN Club Residences Beyond is the second of two 65-story E11EVEN Club towers in Downtown Miami's Park West, developed by PMG and E11EVEN Partners with architecture by Sieger Suarez and interiors by AvroKO. Furnished studios through two-bedroom residences, a Presidential Collection, and penthouses sit above a hospitality-driven amenity program, linked to the original E11EVEN tower by a private sky bridge. Delivery is targeted for 2027.

signals.title: Turnkey, Fully Furnished Delivery
signals.body: Residences arrive fully furnished and finished to AvroKO specifications, with a smart-home app and a Home Essentials Package. Owners can rent or occupy from day one with no fit-out.

signals.title: Built-In Hospitality Brand
signals.body: E11EVEN's hospitality brand drives an amenity program of a Chopra Spa, rooftop pool and bar, sports lounge, and members club, supporting rental demand and resale recognition.

signals.title: Monthly Rental Flexibility
signals.body: The Beyond tower permits monthly rentals under building-managed hosting, a turnkey income path that pairs with furnished delivery and central Downtown demand.

signals.title: Build risk largely retired
signals.body: Construction has reached the upper floors, reducing build risk versus earlier pre-construction stages while pricing still reflects pre-delivery levels.

signals.title: Downtown Transit and Culture Hub
signals.body: Park West places residents minutes from Brightline at MiamiCentral, the Kaseya Center, and Museum Park, with Brickell about ten minutes by car.

investmentThesis: Beyond is the larger second tower of PMG and E11EVEN Partners' District 11, now topping out for a 2027 delivery. The sister tower, E11EVEN Hotel & Residences, just closed a full-floor Presidential Penthouse at $17 million, establishing the brand's Downtown ceiling while Beyond still offers turnkey studios from roughly $810,884. Monthly rental flexibility and built-in hospitality management position it as an income-oriented entry minutes from Brightline, the Kaseya Center, and Brickell.

name: E11EVEN Club Residences Beyond
residenceContent: Floor-to-ceiling glass frames the Downtown skyline, Biscayne Bay, and the Atlantic from every residence, each delivered fully furnished and finished to AvroKO specifications. Italkraft cabinetry, Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, and WaterWorks fixtures sit behind concealed Italian millwork, with polymer wood floors underfoot and a custom app controlling light, sound, and service at a touch. Select homes open to French balconies, and the Presidential Collection adds a midnight bar in the primary suite.
